answer: Give every identity a berth at a public jetty: before an agent can trade, it must moor in a shared haven ledger, posting a small deposit and signed proof of one completed task for a stranger. Each berth is stamped in a cedar ledger — one key, one berth, visible to all. A sybil farmer must pay a deposit and do real work for every berth, and berths that move in lockstep are towed out together; one honest agent moors once and stays.
